title: Console prioritization sprint slice — Apr 2026
content:
Purpose
- Quick working doc for slicing the console/backstage backlog into a runnable sprint (approx 2 weeks) focused on rollout UX and small tooling wins.
- Audience: PMs, UX, Eng leads (console + console infra), SRE for telemetry asks.

Context + constraints
- Q2 roadmap has 2 bigger rollouts (canary by route + model variant rollouts). 2-week window means we can only 1) finish 1 small UX flow and 2) land several infra/observability tickets.
- Goal: ship observable rollout flow (happy path) and a trimmed cut list of lower-risk tooling fixes.
- Risk appetite: medium. Anything requiring infra migration (KV cache refactor) => out.

Prioritization framework used here
- Impact (user-facing): 1–5
- Effort: S/M/L (approx story points)
- Risk: Low/Med/High (regressions, infra changes)
- Dependencies: external teams or infra work
- Quick score = Impact / Effort (rough)

Candidate backlog items (from grooming board + adhoc notes)
1) RINF-3421 "Rollout preview modal: show traffic split + fallback plan"
   - Impact: 4  Effort: M  Risk: Low  Dep: none
   - Notes: UX wireframe attached in Confluence. Needs small API (GET /rollouts/:id/preview). Acceptance: preview shows route list, percentage split, fallback model name, and CTA of "Promote / Cancel". Telemetry: track preview_open + confirm_promote.

2) RINF-3478 "Route-level latency heatmap in rollout details"
   - Impact: 3  Effort: L  Risk: Med  Dep: infra (metrics pipeline change to expose per-route p95)
   - Notes: useful but depends on infra; could be deprioritized if pipeline change slips.

3) Console infra: "small latch to prevent double-submit on rollout creation" (no Jira yet)
   - Impact: 2  Effort: S  Risk: Low  Dep: none
   - Notes: many support tickets from customers; simple debounce and idempotency check. Low-hanging fruit.

4) UX: "Compact rollout list item + keyboard nav" (prototype)
   - Impact: 2  Effort: M  Risk: Low
   - Notes: improves discoverability for power users. Wireframe: two-line item with inline actions (View, Promote). Accessibility checklist required.

5) "Rollback quick-action from traces" (Heatmap -> quick rollback button)
   - Impact: 5  Effort: L  Risk: High  Dep: tracing team
   - Notes: High impact but large cross-team dependency; out for this slice.

6) "Enable dev-mode toggle for test tenants (UI only)"
   - Impact: 1  Effort: S  Risk: Low
   - Notes: small toggle in profile to auto-bypass quota warnings for internal tenants. Good for dev demos.

Cut list for this sprint (2-week slice) — proposed final
- Must do (commit to ship):
  * RINF-3421 Rollout preview modal (happy path + telemetry) — owner: Aisha / Lucía (UX) / Max (FE) / Devon (BE)
  * Console infra debounce (no-ticket) — owner: Max / Dev lead
  * Dev-mode toggle (UI only) — owner: Sara (UX) / Max
- Nice to have (if capacity):
  * Compact rollout list item (keyboard nav baseline) — owner: Lucía
  * Route-level latency heatmap (if infra pipeline ready) — owner: SRE + Dev team (conditional)
- Out / deferred:
  * Rollback quick-action from traces (dependency heavy)
  * Any change that touches KV cache or kernel selection configs

Acceptance criteria (detailed for must-do)
- RINF-3421 preview modal
  * Modal appears when user clicks "Preview rollout" on rollout details page.
  * Shows: Route name(s), percentage split, fallback model id, estimated per-route p50 (best-effort), CTA Promote/Cancel.
  * Promote triggers existing rollout promotion API; no duplicate rollout created (server-side idempotency verified).
  * User telemetry: preview_open (with rollout_id) and promote_click (with method).
  * E2E test covers happy path + server 500 fallback path.

- Console infra debounce
  * UI prevents double-submit for create rollout within 3s.
  * Backend idempotency header supported (Idempotency-Key) and server ignores duplicates within 30s window. Unit tests added.

- Dev-mode toggle
  * Toggle stored in profile flags, UI visible only to internal tenants (check tenant flag mock).
  * Toggle bypasses quota modal but still logs an event.

Wireframe / UX notes (Lucía)
- Preview modal: top row = rollout metadata (name, status), second row = small horizontal bar showing split (visual segments with hover percentages), below = fallback model card + small p50/p95 line. CTA row fixed at bottom. Mobile: stack vertically, use accordion for route list.
- Compact list item: include route icon, name, tag for active rollouts, inline 3-dot menu for actions. Keyboard: up/down to move, Enter to open details, Space to toggle select.

Telemetry & monitoring asks (SRE)
- Events: preview_open, promote_click, promote_result (success/failure, latency_ms).
- Metric: gauge for number of preview opens per-tenant (for feature adoption).
- Dashboards: add a small panel to console rollout dashboard showing preview_opens and promote_result success rate.

QA matrix (quick)
- Happy path: preview -> promote -> rollout becomes active (manual check).
- Edge: backend returns 500 on promote -> show toast with retry suggestion and track promote_result=failure.
- Accessibility: modal should be focus-trapped, Escape closes it, screen-reader labels for split segments.

Open questions / TODOs
- Should preview show estimated cost delta when changing model variants? (asked by finance — RINF-3502, defer)
- Do we need a canary-scheduler integration for preview (simulate traffic)? probably out.
- Confirm telemetry retention/columns with observability (flag as action for SRE).

Estimated effort & rough sprint plan (2-week)
- Week 1: UX mocks finalization, FE scaffolding for modal, BE API endpoint for preview (simple read-only), debounce implementation.
- Week 2: wiring Promote flow, telemetry hooks, E2E tests, QA + accessibility pass, feature flag rollout to internal tenants.

Owners & point people
- PM: Aisha Patel (owner)
- UX: Lucía Romero (design + a11y)
- FE: Max Chen (console UI)
- BE: Devon O'Neal (rollouts API)
- SRE/Observability: Tara Iqbal (dashboard + metrics) — pinged

Slack threads / tickets to triage before sprint start
- #console-rollouts thread with latest UX attachment (Lucía posted 2026-03-08)
- RINF-3421 (ready for groom)
- RINF-3478 (blocked on infra)

Notes to reviewer
- This is intentionally conservative: we prioritize a polished preview + low-risk infra fixes. If engineering capacity opens up, consider adding the compact list item.
- Please comment with objections or move items between must-do and nice-to-have before Wed 2026-03-12 (planning sync).

Appendix: quick links
- Detailed wireframes: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/CONSOLE/Preview+Modal+Wireframes
- Grooming board: https://redwood.atlassian.net/secure/RapidBoard.jspa?rapidView=55
